_about: English translations of the Portuguese reviews the dashboard displays (complaint-group quotes and the Action Center queue). Display only: every model, search and metric runs on the original Portuguese. Translated once with an LLM; phone numbers, personal names and tracking codes are left out of the English text. Store names (Lannister, Stark, Targaryen, Baratheon) are the dataset's own anonymised seller names.

translations.Adquiri o Aparador de pelos Seco & Molha: I bought the Philips BG2024/15 wet & dry trimmer for R$257.87, but received the Philips QT4015/15 trimmer, which on the store's own site
translations.Não sei o motivo, mas dos 4 ítens adquir: I don't know why, but of the 4 units I bought of the same product, only 3 were delivered. They were shipped individually and one is still missing
translations.Falha na entrega. Comprei dois produtos: Delivery failure. I bought two products and only one was delivered
translations.Gostaria de sabe pq não venhor o inalado: I'd like to know why the right inhaler didn't come. I ordered one and got another, and I can't reach the seller
translations.paguei 2 e recebi 1. Comprei 2 remedios: I paid for 2 and received 1. I bought 2 medicines and they only delivered 1. I need the medicines
translations.Eu comprei uma prancha profissional anti: I bought a professional anti-frizz 230 dual-voltage hair straightener, and what came was a CP9 professional that doesn't say it's anti-frizz. I also didn't like how it straightens
translations.Bonita, pratica, porém a tampa da churra: Nice and practical, but the grill lid is heavier than the body and the lid stopper doesn't hold its weight, so it falls. The grill handles came bent and are flimsy too
translations.ENTREGARAM O PRODUTO ERRADO (DIFERENTE D: THEY DELIVERED THE WRONG PRODUCT (DIFFERENT FROM THE LISTING) AND IT'S FAULTY!!! I CAN'T REACH LANNISTER BECAUSE IT WAS SOLD "BY A PARTNER"... I'VE SENT MESSAGES AND NOTHING!!!! WHAT NOW??
translations.produto errado. Não foi entregue a másca: Wrong product. The repair hair mask wasn't delivered, and the sealant was badly packed and leaked a lot. The lid had no seal. Not recommended. Very bad
The company delivered a counterfeit supplement. Totally irresponsible with the customer's health. Stark also loses credibility by accepting dishonest partner companies
translations.Não enviaram Nota Fiscal e atrasaram um: They didn't send an invoice and the delivery was a bit late
translations.Produto não funciona. O a cinta do produ: The product doesn't work. The product's belt isn't working
translations.Nao tem boa avaliação por atraso na entr: Not a good rating because of the late delivery
translations.Demorou de mais pra chegar, se tivesse c: It took far too long to arrive. If I'd bought from abroad it wouldn't have taken this long
translations.O produto veio com furos errado para mon: The product came with the assembly holes in the wrong place. Unfortunately the chair won't last 3 months. I won't buy self-assembly products online any more
translations.Fiz pedido de 02 jogos de toalhas e cheg: I ordered 2 towel sets and only 1 set arrived!
translations.Efetuei a compra de 04 unidades conforme: I bought 4 units, as the invoice shows, but received only 1. So 3 units are missing. Waiting for an urgent reply because I need the goods
translations.Comprei 02 e só recebi 01. Comprei 02 ba: I bought 2 and only received 1. I bought 2 scales and only got 1. I sent a message and nothing so far
translations.Rastreamento: PP 272 681 476 BR Ainda nã: Tracking: [tracking code removed]. It still hasn't reached the post office unit in Porto Alegre
translations.Efetuei a compra de duas cortinas, mas r: I bought two curtains but only received one
translations.O botão para abrir o carro não está func: The button to open the car doesn't work
translations.Produto veio com amassados e também não: The product came dented and also doesn't work properly
translations.Produto não entregue. Pensei que seria e: Product not delivered. I thought it would arrive before the deadline, but nothing at all
translations.Não recomendo.. Relógio não valeu o que: Not recommended. The watch wasn't worth what I paid. Low-quality material. I don't think Lannister stores should sell "street-vendor watches"
translations.PRODUTO ERRADO. SOLICITEI OUTRO MODELO E: WRONG PRODUCT. I ORDERED A DIFFERENT MODEL WITH MORE ML
translations.Eu compro sempre nesta loja e gosto: I always buy from this store and I like it
translations.Comprei um quadro é um adesivo de parede: I bought a picture and a wall sticker. For an unexplained reason the sticker wasn't delivered. I want to know when I'll be refunded
translations.Então realizei a compra toda nunta e ape: I placed the whole order together and only 1 item arrived, though I bought 4 items!
translations.Pedido veio faltando item. Nunca tive pr: The order came with an item missing. I'd never had a problem with Lannister stores, which is why I chose to buy from you. Unfortunately it didn't meet my expectations
translations.comunico aos responsáveis que só recebe: Please note that I only received one of the two kits I bought. I kindly ask you to send the other one, as I paid for both
translations.recebi o produto mas pelo que identifiqu: I received the product, but as far as I can tell it's fake, not the same as in the listing photos. Very annoying. Lannister should control its third-party sellers more strictly
translations.Nao recebi tudo. Foi entregue apenas 2 c: I didn't receive everything. Only 2 chair covers were delivered, without the tablecloth and the other 4 chair covers, and a very high price was charged for delivery
translations.Não recomendado. Apesar de estar no praz: Not recommended. Although it was within the delivery deadline, the product took a long time. I ordered the same product from a competitor of Stark and it arrived much sooner
translations.Postou o produto na véspera da data esti: They posted the product the day before the promised delivery date
translations.O produto levou quase um mês para chegar: The product took almost a month to arrive. I bought the curtain three weeks ahead to host friends at home and it didn't arrive in time to be installed. I should have bought it in a shop
translations.é uma merda. bem comprei um produto que: It's rubbish. I bought a R$261 product, the best they had, with a 32 GB card, and they sent me their worst, a R$140 one with a 16 GB card. In short, crooks!!!
translations.Me entregaram FALTANDO um vidro de perfu: They delivered it with a perfume bottle MISSING
translations.Pois a tela do encosto da cadeira estava: The mesh on the chair's backrest was torn
translations.Estou aguardando o contato da empresa pa: I'm waiting for the company to contact me to fix the delivery that was missing a product
translations.Comprei duas luminárias iguais. Chegou u: I bought two identical lamps. A big box arrived with only one lamp, the invoice lists 2 lamps and the status says delivered. A real hassle to sort out
translations.PÉSSIMO. COMOREI 4 VIDROS DE VITAMINA D3: TERRIBLE. I BOUGHT 4 BOTTLES OF VITAMIN D3, PAID EXPENSIVE SHIPPING AND ONLY RECEIVED 3. I WANT THE FOURTH; IT ALL COST R$260
translations.Estão faltando duas garrafas de vinho!!!: Two bottles of wine are missing!!! I bought 6 and only 4 came. Please take action. Regards
translations.Simplesmente vc paga por 2 produtos mas: You simply pay for 2 products, but the store/site delivers one and charges you for 2. Unbelievable!!!
translations.Produto de péssima qualidade. Já chegou: Very poor quality. The top arrived with its screws loose because of the terrible wood. It came with 4 legs to screw on, with no instructions or manual. Very bad
translations.produto incompleto. a montagem esta muit: Incomplete product. Assembly is very difficult and a part is missing. I didn't like it
translations.A caixa do produto chegou toda amassada(: The product's own box arrived completely crushed (not the shipping box, the product box itself), and the sword it holds is bent from being pressed. Sad
translations.Não gostei de ter que ir retirar no corr: I didn't like having to collect it at the post office. I still have to assemble it and fix it to the wall; I'll rate again afterwards. At first it seems fine
translations.serviço mediano. Produto chegou rápido,: Average service. The product arrived quickly, but it seems it was badly stored: it had stains and was dirty (looks like it had been in stock a long time)
translations.O entregador contratado não permitiu a c: The courier wouldn't let me check the product before signing. He threatened to take the delivery back, and as soon as I signed he rushed off. He didn't hand over the invoice. Extremely rude
translations.O cor e estampa não é igual que a foto,m: The colour and print aren't the same as the photo, but... I liked it
translations.Produto de baixa qualidad. Produto de ba: Low-quality product. The photo is very misleading. The left button does nothing; the digital display only works if you press one of the two right buttons and then turns off. Instructions in English and Chinese
translations.A loja anuncia um produto e entrega outr: The store advertises one product and delivers another
translations.Só chegou 1 dos dois produtos comprados: Only 1 of the 2 products I bought arrived: the BCAA came, but the Hemo-Rage Black is missing
translations.Comprei 02 produtos e só recebi 01: I bought 2 products and only received 1
translations.Relógio veio sem bateria (o que não é no: The watch came without a battery (not normal for this brand). I took it to a watchmaker and the PROFESSIONAL said with certainty it's a fake, second-rate product, though I bought it as original
translations.Entrega de apenas uma cap. Comprei duas: Only one cap delivered. I bought two units but only one was in the package. I want to know what happened: I paid for two and got one
translations.Uma cadeira veio faltando a parte do enc: One chair came without the backrest part
translations.A loja recomendo mas não o produto que e: I recommend the store but not the product I chose. I want a refund. The sheet is rough just to the touch; I didn't even take it out of the packaging
translations.Falta produtos do pedido. Chegou 1 unid: Products missing from the order. Only 1 of the 2 tea towels came and only 1 of the 2 glass jars I ordered. Missing: one 1.7 l glass jar and one tea towel. Please take action. Thank you
translations.não recomendo. os pendentes vieram desca: Not recommended. The pendant lamps came peeling, one was dented, and the gold finish was defective
translations.Efetuei uma compra de dois produtos igua: I bought two identical products, only one came, and to this day nothing has been resolved
translations.Pedi uma colcha 100% algodão e veio 100%: I ordered a 100% cotton bedspread and it came 100% polyester
translations.Quando inciei com as lojas lannister ach: When I started buying from Lannister stores I thought it was great, but the lack of consideration on this last purchase makes me very sad about how little attention they pay to customers. To this day
translations.o pedido é entregue em separado, comprei: The order is delivered in pieces: I bought 7 items that came in 3 packages on 3 different dates, and one item is still missing
translations.PEDIDO INCOMPLETO. Cobrado duas caixas d: INCOMPLETE ORDER. I was charged for two boxes of contact lenses, as on the invoice, but only one box arrived. I use different prescriptions for each eye. They picked the order wrong and the company still hasn't contacted me
translations.O anúncio diz que o produto tem 6cm de a: The listing says the product is 6 cm tall with 4 cm bristles. Not true: what I received is less than 4 cm tall
translations.Não gostei do material você se seca e co: I didn't like the material: you dry yourself and stay wet. For the price, the product should be better
translations.eu recebi as duas panelas elétrica errad: I received the wrong two electric pans: they came in 220 V and I ordered 110 V. I'd like to exchange them because I only have 110 V sockets. How do I do it? Can you help me please
I received part of the order, the sheet set. I bought a placemat set in the same order AND DIDN'T RECEIVE IT. WAITING FOR ACTION
translations.Além do prazo de entrega ser super demor: Besides the very long delivery time, now I can't contact them to find out what's happening and when, or if, they'll deliver
translations.Já comprei com as lannister e o produto: I've bought from Lannister before and the product arrived on time; this order from their partner Targaryen is late
